text: ＊　＊で　だげきこうげきに　すこし　つよくなった！

structure.jp: すこし　つよくなった！

patterns.name: 〜くなる
patterns.explanation: A describing word with its い changed to く, followed by なる, means 'become that way'. つよくなった = 'became strong'.

patterns.name: 〜で (cause)
patterns.explanation: で after a thing can show what caused the result. ＊で = 'because of ＊'.
